relations.subject: Vilhelm Ludwig Peter Thomsen
relations.evidence: He studied at the University of Copenhagen in 1859, graduating in 1867 and earning a PhD in 1869

relations.subject: Vilhelm Ludwig Peter Thomsen
relations.evidence: He taught Greek at the Borgerdyd school in Copenhagen before becoming a professor at the University of Copenhagen.

relations.subject: Vilhelm Ludwig Peter Thomsen
relations.evidence: From 1875, he was an associate professor of comparative linguistics at the University of Copenhagen

relations.subject: Vilhelm Ludwig Peter Thomsen
relations.evidence: and in 1887 he was appointed professor.

relations.subject: Vilhelm Ludwig Peter Thomsen
relations.evidence: Thomsen was President of the Danish Academy from 1909 until his death

relations.subject: Vilhelm Ludwig Peter Thomsen
relations.evidence: Thomsen married Karen Charlotte Allen (22 August 1852 – 15 August 1934), a daughter of historian C.F. Allen (1811–71) and Ide Marie Dorph (1812–1910), on 5 May 1876

relations.subject: Emil Nestor Setälä
relations.evidence: Thomsen's daughter Kristiane Nicoline Thomsen (1877–1968) was the second wife of the Finnish linguist Emil Nestor Setälä.
